name: redact
description: Hides secrets (API keys, tokens, private keys) from the model in prompts and tool results, and refuses tool calls that inline one

denyInlineSecrets.title: Tool calls that inline a secret
denyInlineSecrets.description: deny: refuse a call whose input holds a secret literal (16+ characters, not obviously fake) and tell the model to read it at run time; warn: run it and show a toast; off: do nothing. A call can opt out with a line "redact-allow: <kind>".
